scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Brad Miller and I'm 30. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I can look at that. Can you tell me your full name and age again so I can pull up your file?
I just said that, it's Brad Miller and I'm 30.
Right, okay. I see a charge for $76 from 'Global Tech Services'. Do you recognize that?
No, I definitely don't have any subscriptions or purchases with a company by that name.
Look, I'm not really sure what this is. I'm just going to go ahead and escalate this to our fraud department since I can't see the details of the transaction on my end.
Wait, can't you just reverse it? I really don't want to wait for a whole fraud investigation if it's just a simple error.
I don't have the authority to just refund it. That's just our policy. I've already sent the ticket to the specialists, so you'll hear from them in 3-5 business days.

escalation_reason: Agent claimed lack of authority to resolve the dispute and inability to view transaction details, defaulting to fraud department escalation.
